about:
Plain Text Threats explains one cybersecurity concept per Short: how real attacks work and how to defend against them, in plain English. No jargon, no fearmongering.

New Short every hour: passwords, phishing, 2FA, encryption, scams, privacy, Wi-Fi, malware, and how to get into a cyber career.

Educational content only. Every Short lists its sources in the description. Voiceover is AI-generated (text-to-speech).
